The hub is a set of plain CSV files, one per normalized entity, joined by stable identifiers that are assigned once and never reused. The files live in the repository's [`data/`]({{< var hub.repo_url >}}/tree/main/data) folder. For reproducible work, read them at a pinned tag or commit, not from `main` (see [Use this hub](using.qmd)).
